candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly for words, roots, and sub-word tokens related to robots, robotics, and automation technology.
This vector represents common Italian grammatical elements, pronouns, and prepositions.
This vector represents suffixes and roots associated with capability, possibility, and feasibility across Romance languages.
This feature vector represents human beings, including words for men, women, and people across different languages.
This vector represents common Italian grammatical words and everyday adverbs.

These tokens represent prepositions and contracted preposition-article combinations in Romance languages, primarily Italian and French, expressing origin, possession, or agency (such as "of", "from", and "by").
This feature vector represents common Italian and multilingual lexical roots, grammatical suffixes, and common nouns.
The tokens represent subword units, suffixes, or root fragments related to the Latin-derived root "pul-" meaning push or drive, commonly found in words like pulse, impulse, and pulsation.
This vector activates on tokens containing or related to the Greek-derived prefix "auto-" meaning self or automatic.
This vector activates on common Italian and Portuguese verb roots, prefixes, and morphologic stems.
